propositions: edit --review must parse as a valueless flag without consuming the next token, then invoke review_plan after the EDIT commit and exit with the disposition code (0/1/2/11) mapped from the verdict dict

claim --review must invoke claim_gate_check and review_plan only when the gate applies; claim proceeds only on PASS verdict; on BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/retryable-degrade it prints the summary and exits (1/2/11) without invoking the claim core

Both flags must obtain _disposition_exit_code via lazy in-function import following the established pattern; when review_plan raises, the exception propagates through the standard CLI error handler with the edit committed (edit --review) or claim never attempted (claim --review)
claim --review must print a skip notice when the plan-review gate does not apply (disabled or exempt type) and proceed with the claim
Neither flag holds the store flock while the review runs; the LLM passes execute with no lock held

The flag is not propagated through the parent-first cascade; help texts document non-atomicity and reference review-plan --status; docs/exit-codes.md documents the new exit codes and states flagless contracts are unchanged
